name: animica-chat
description: Animica Chat — focused AI workspace. $10/month USD subscription, no ANM required.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm -C server dev" "pnpm -C web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm -C server build && pnpm -C web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C server typecheck && pnpm -C web typecheck

pnpm.//: Pin a single Prisma so server + web share the generated client.
